column1: # Rust runtime transition gates. A native pack (rustc --cfg jet_native_pack) links the
# Jet runtime object first; it defines every #Export(c) of Compiler/JetRuntime/sources.list

# Each row is one cfg(jet_native_pack) gate kept only while a Rust-tier consumer links
# the Rust runtime. Delete the Rust side and its row when the removal condition holds;
# no gate outlives B9 (Rust runtime tier retired).
